title: Run 26: anomaly-driven niche hunting
predecessors: run_024 (48 concepts) + run_025 (98 cumulative) — combination-mining SATURATED (0 niches clear gates; 2 sub-gate residuals).
reframe: From COMBINATION (generate niche by fusing concepts -> always collides, candidate space saturated) to ANOMALY hunting (find where ML measurement != theoretical prediction, still UNRESOLVED). Physics precedent: Vera Rubin galaxy-rotation measurement != Newtonian prediction -> dark matter. An unresolved anomaly is novel by definition.

pipeline.PHASE_1: Agent: source 8 REPORTED empirical anomalies in ML/LLM (measurement contradicts prediction), verbatim (R5). NOT combinations.
pipeline.PHASE_2: Agent: for each anomaly, search 'has it been explained/resolved?' -> which are UNRESOLVED (no accepted explanation).
pipeline.PHASE_3: Opus agent: for the 5 most-unresolved, propose a SPECIFIC explanatory mechanism + testable prediction (the 'dark matter' hypothesis).
pipeline.PHASE_4: Agent: verify anomaly is real + unexplained (5 reformulations) + crosscheck.
pipeline.PHASE_5: Agent: audit (logic-break + genuinely-unresolved-not-just-under-cited + testable_prediction actually testable).

gates.gate_3: anomaly is UNRESOLVED (no ACCEPTED explanation, verified by search — R13 STRICT)
gates.gate_4: proposed explanation is CONCRETE + makes a TESTABLE prediction

hard_rules.R5: Record ONLY real search results; NEVER fabricate.
hard_rules.R12: Combination saturates; test whether ANOMALY escapes it.
hard_rules.R13: STRICT: 'unresolved' = no ACCEPTED explanation verified by search, not 'I didn't find one'. Anomaly with existing explanation = REJECT.
hard_rules.R14: If an anomaly clears all gates, it's a real lead (open problem + testable hypothesis). Verify hard; do not explain away.

deviation_note: Phase-3 'claude -p --model opus' realized via the native Agent tool (independent Opus context) per R3 intent; no shell subprocess/tempdir needed. Pipeline is sequential.
